bagPolicy.summary: Fontainebleau Las Vegas does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Fontainebleau Las Vegas offers complimentary self-parking for Nevada residents and Fontainebleau Rewards members until May 31, 2026. Hotel guests enjoy complimentary self-parking for the duration of their stay. Self-parking costs $20 for up to 24 hours after complimentary eligibility ends, with special event pricing applicable during certain times.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Fontainebleau Las Vegas's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Fontainebleau Las Vegas offers 24-hour in-room dining with a variety of global-inspired menu options. Guests can enjoy breakfast, lunch, dinner, and late-night dining, with specific hours for each meal period. Orders can be placed via phone or online.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Fontainebleau Las Vegas, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Fontainebleau Las Vegas's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Fontainebleau Las Vegas. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Fontainebleau Las Vegas. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
